summary: Indaptus Therapeutics filed Amendment No. 1 to its prospectus supplement under an S-3 shelf, correcting clerical errors in the dilution section for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $100 million through H.C. Wainwright. No shares had been sold under the prior supplement. The amendment restates net tangible book value calculations and dilution to new investors. This is a routine regulatory correction for a capital raise, not a special situation.
